sentences.zh: 山南道山南道，蓋古荊、梁二州之域，漢南郡、武陵、巴郡、漢中、南陽及江夏、弘農、廣漢、武都郡地。

translations.literal: Shannan Circuit, Shannan Circuit — roughly the domain of the ancient Jing and Liang provinces, comprising the Han-era territories of Nan, Wuling, Ba, Hanzhong, and Nanyang commanderies, and Jiangxia, Hongnong, Guanghan, and Wudu commanderies.

sentences.zh: 翱以尚書考功員外郎，造以起居舍人，出為刺史，故以官名。

translations.literal: Beiting Metropolitan Protectorate General, Beiting Metropolitan Protectorate General — originally Ting Prefecture; in Zhenguan 14 Gaochang was pacified and it was established from the Western Turk Nivoshabo Liye protector Ashina Helu's tribe, and Puchang County was also established; soon abolished; restored in Xianqing 3; in Chang'an 2 it became Beiting Protectorate General.
translations.idiomatic: Beiting Metropolitan Protectorate General — originally Ting Prefecture; in Zhenguan 14 Gaochang was pacified and it was established from the Western Turk Nivoshabo Liye protector Ashina Helu's tribe, with Puchang County also established; soon abolished, restored in Xianqing 3, and made Beiting Protectorate General in Chang'an 2.

sentences.zh: 土貢：陰牙角、速霍角、阿魏截根。

translations.literal: Local tribute: dark ivory horn, suhuo horn, and asafetida root sections.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute: dark ivory horn, suhuo horn, and asafetida root sections.

sentences.zh: 戶二千二百二十六，口九千九百六十四。

translations.literal: 2,226 households and 9,964 mouths.
translations.idiomatic: It registered 2,226 households and 9,964 mouths.

translations.literal: Four counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed four counties.

sentences.zh: 有瀚海軍，本燭龍軍，長安二年置，三年更名，開元中蓋嘉運增築。

translations.literal: It had Hanhai Army, originally Zhulong Army, established in Chang'an 2 and renamed in year 3; in the Kaiyuan era Gai Jiayun expanded its fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: It had Hanhai Army, originally Zhulong Army, established in Chang'an 2 and renamed in year 3; in the Kaiyuan era Gai Jiayun expanded its fortifications.

sentences.zh: 西七百里有清海軍，本清海鎮，天寶中為軍。

translations.literal: Seven hundred li west was Qinghai Army, originally Qinghai Fort, made an army in the Tianbao era.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai Army lay seven hundred li west, originally Qinghai Fort and made an army in the Tianbao era.

translations.literal: To the south was Shenshan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Shenshan Fort lay to the south.

sentences.zh: 自庭州西延城西六十里有沙鉢城守捉，又有馮洛守捉，又八十里有耶勒城守捉，又八十里有俱六城守捉，又百里至輪臺縣，又百五十里有張堡城守捉，又渡里移得建河，七十里有烏宰守捉，又渡白楊河，七十里有清鎮軍城，又渡葉葉河，七十里有葉河守捉，又渡黑水，七十里有黑水守捉，又七十里有東林守捉，又七十里有西林守捉。

translations.literal: From Ting Prefecture, west of Yanxi City sixty li was Shabo City defense garrison; there was also Fengluo defense garrison; another eighty li was Yele City defense garrison; another eighty li was Juliu City defense garrison; another one hundred li to Luntai County; another one hundred fifty li was Zhangbao City defense garrison; crossing the Liyidejian River, seventy li away was Wuzai defense garrison; crossing the White Poplar River, seventy li away was Qingzhen Army City; crossing the Yeye River, seventy li away was Yehe defense garrison; crossing the Black Water, seventy li away was Heishui defense garrison; another seventy li was Donglin defense garrison; another seventy li was Xilin defense garrison.
translations.idiomatic: From Ting Prefecture west of Yanxi City, Shabo City defense garrison lay sixty li away, with Fengluo defense garrison beyond; Yele City defense garrison eighty li farther, Juliu City defense garrison eighty li beyond that, Luntai County one hundred li on, Zhangbao City defense garrison one hundred fifty li farther; crossing the Liyidejian River, Wuzai defense garrison lay seventy li away; crossing the White Poplar River, Qingzhen Army City seventy li on; crossing the Yeye River, Yehe defense garrison seventy li farther; crossing the Black Water, Heishui defense garrison seventy li on; Donglin defense garrison seventy li beyond, and Xilin defense garrison seventy li farther.

sentences.zh: 又經黃草泊、大漠、小磧，渡石漆河，踰車嶺，至弓月城。

translations.literal: Continuing through Yellow Grass Marsh, the great desert, and small desert, crossing Shipi River, crossing Che Ridge, to Gongyue City.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing through Yellow Grass Marsh, the great desert, and small desert, crossing Shipi River and Che Ridge to Gongyue City.

sentences.zh: 過思渾川、蟄失蜜城，渡伊麗河，一名帝帝河，至碎葉界。

translations.literal: Passing Sihun River and Zheshimi City, crossing Yili River — also called Didi River — to the Suyab boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Sihun River and Zheshimi City, crossing Yili River — also called Didi River — to the Suyab boundary.

sentences.zh: 又西行千里至碎葉城，水皆北流入磧及入夷播海。

translations.literal: Continuing west one thousand li to Suyab City; all waters flowed north into the desert and into Yibohai.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing west one thousand li to Suyab City, all waters flowed north into the desert and into Yibohai.

translations.literal: Jinman, lower.
translations.idiomatic: Jinman, lower.

translations.literal: Luntai, lower.
translations.idiomatic: Luntai, lower.

translations.literal: It had Jingsai Army, established in Dali 6.
translations.idiomatic: It had Jingsai Army, established in Dali 6.

translations.literal: Houting, lower.
translations.idiomatic: Houting, lower.

sentences.zh: 本蒲類，隸西州，後來屬，寶應元年更名。

translations.literal: Originally Pulei, subordinate to Xi Prefecture; later came under this prefecture; renamed in Baoying 1.
translations.idiomatic: Originally Pulei, subordinate to Xi Prefecture, it later came under this prefecture and was renamed in Baoying 1.

sentences.zh: 有蒲類、郝遮、鹹泉三鎮，特羅堡。

translations.literal: It had Pulei, Haozhe, and Xianquan forts and Teluo Fort.
translations.idiomatic: It had Pulei, Haozhe, and Xianquan forts and Teluo Fort.

translations.literal: Xihai.
translations.idiomatic: Xihai.

translations.literal: Lower.
translations.idiomatic: Rank: lower.

translations.literal: Established in Baoying 1.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Baoying 1.

sentences.zh: 安西大都護府安西大都護府，初治西州。

translations.literal: Anxi Metropolitan Protectorate General, Anxi Metropolitan Protectorate General — initially administered from Xi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Anxi Metropolitan Protectorate General — initially administered from Xi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 顯慶二年平賀魯，析其地置濛池、崑陵二都護府，分種落列置州縣，西盡波斯國，皆隸安西，又徙治高昌故地。

translations.literal: In Xianqing 2 Helu was pacified; his territory was divided to establish Mengchi and Kunling protectorates; tribal groups were arranged into prefectures and counties west to Persia, all subordinate to Anxi; the seat was moved to the old Gaochang site.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianqing 2 Helu was pacified; his territory was divided to establish Mengchi and Kunling protectorates, tribal groups were arranged into prefectures and counties west to Persia, all subordinate to Anxi, and the seat moved to the old Gaochang site.

sentences.zh: 三年徙治龜茲都督府，而故府復為西州。

translations.literal: In year 3 the seat moved to Kucha Protectorate Prefecture, and the former headquarters again became Xi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 the seat moved to Kucha Protectorate Prefecture, and the former headquarters again became Xi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 咸亨元年，吐蕃陷都護府。

translations.literal: In Xianhe 1 the Tibetans captured the protectorate general's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianhe 1 the Tibetans captured the protectorate general's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 長壽二年收復安西四鎮。

translations.literal: In Changshou 2 the four Anxi garrisons were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In Changshou 2 the four Anxi garrisons were recovered.

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhide it was renamed Zhenxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhide it was renamed Zhenxi.

translations.literal: Later it was again called Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was again called Anxi.

translations.literal: Local tribute: natron, crimson felt, and pistachio kernels.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute: natron, crimson felt, and pistachio kernels.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃既侵河、隴，惟李元忠守北庭，郭昕守安西，與沙陀、迴紇相依，吐蕃攻之久不下。

translations.literal: Once the Tibetans had invaded the He and Long regions, only Li Yuanzhong held Beiting and Guo Xin held Anxi, relying on the Shatuo and Uyghurs; the Tibetans besieged them for a long time without success.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Tibetans had invaded the He and Long regions, only Li Yuanzhong held Beiting and Guo Xin held Anxi, relying on the Shatuo and Uyghurs; the Tibetans besieged them for a long time without success.

sentences.zh: 建中二年，元忠、昕遣使間道入奏，詔各以為大都護，並為節度。

translations.literal: In Jianzhong 2 Yuanzhong and Xin sent envoys by concealed routes to memorialize the throne; each was appointed metropolitan protector and also made military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianzhong 2 Yuanzhong and Xin sent envoys by concealed routes to memorialize the throne; each was appointed metropolitan protector and also made military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 貞元三年，吐蕃攻沙陀、迴紇，北庭、安西無援，遂陷。

translations.literal: In Zhenyuan 3 the Tibetans attacked the Shatuo and Uyghurs; Beiting and Anxi had no reinforcements and finally fell.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 3 the Tibetans attacked the Shatuo and Uyghurs; Beiting and Anxi had no reinforcements and finally fell.

translations.literal: It had Baoda Army, garrisoned at Suyab City.
translations.idiomatic: It had Baoda Army, garrisoned at Suyab City.

sentences.zh: 于闐東界有蘭城、坎城二守捉城。

translations.literal: On the eastern border of Khotan were Lan City and Kan City, two defense garrison towns.
translations.idiomatic: On the eastern border of Khotan were Lan City and Kan City, two defense garrison towns.

sentences.zh: 西有葱嶺守捉城，有胡弩、固城、吉良三鎮。

translations.literal: To the west was Congling defense garrison town; it had Hunu, Gucheng, and Jiliang forts.
translations.idiomatic: To the west was Congling defense garrison town; it had Hunu, Gucheng, and Jiliang forts.

translations.literal: To the east was Qiemo Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Qiemo Fort lay to the east.

translations.literal: To the southwest was Pishan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Pishan Fort lay to the southwest.

sentences.zh: 焉耆西有于術、榆林、龍泉、東夷僻、西夷僻、赤岸六守捉城。

translations.literal: West of Yanqi were Yushu, Yulin, Longquan, Dongyipi, Xiyipi, and Chian — six defense garrison towns.
translations.idiomatic: West of Yanqi were Yushu, Yulin, Longquan, Dongyipi, Xiyipi, and Chian — six defense garrison towns.

translations.literal: Above: the Longyou circuit investigative commissioner, seat at Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Longyou circuit investigative commissioner was stationed at Shan Prefecture.
